sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Self-Insurance Risk Underwriting for Multinational Enterprise Groups

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Independent State of Samoa (Malo Sa'oloto Tuto'atasi o Samoa)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa - International Company (IC) regime administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law - English common law heritage as modified by Samoan statute; customary law (fa'asamoa) is confined to land, titles and customary matters and does not govern corporate or commercial law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), signed 2017, in force for Samoa 2020
Samoa-New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA)
China-Samoa economic and technical cooperation instruments (investment facilitation framework; no comprehensive Samoa-PRC bilateral investment treaty currently in force)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2008 (No. 21 of 2008), ss. 6–16 (Incorporation), s. 35 (Registered Office), ss. 74–78 (Directors and Officers); Insurance Act 2007 (captive reinsurer licensing)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and the Registered Agent's Consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company under the International Companies Act 2008; the constitution fixes authorized share capital. For the captive reinsurance licence, SIFA requires a minimum unimpaired solvency margin (typically US$250,000 for a captive reinsurer) maintained in a solvency trust or escrow account with a licensed bank in Samoa, as imposed under the Insurance Act 2007.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged at incorporation be and are hereby adopted as the Company's constitutive instruments, the Company to carry on the business of captive reinsurance underwriting for affiliated multinational enterprise groups. (2) That the subscription of share capital be and is hereby confirmed, and the registered office be established at Levett Drive, Apia, Samoa, as advised to the Registrar of International Companies at the Samoa International Finance Authority. (3) That [Director Name] be and is hereby appointed Director and [Officer Name] appointed Secretary of the Company, with execution authority delegated to the Directors. (4) That the Directors be authorized to apply for the International Insurance Licence (Captive Reinsurer) and ancillary approvals.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search application for the proposed corporate name, which must end with 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation, and obtain a name reservation certificate. The application may be submitted by the licensed registered agent through the SIFA online portal or in person at the SIFA office in Apia.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (Form IC-0)
Certificate of identity of each proposed subscriber or shareholder
Certified passport copy of each subscriber or director
Cover letter from the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, submit a fresh name reservation application with up to three alternative names within 30 days; an appeal may be made to the Registrar for review of a contested refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Samoa; notary public for subscriber signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, incorporating the registered agent's consent, the capital structure, share classes, and restricted objects limited to captive reinsurance and treasury treasury management. Have each subscriber's signature notarized and the document endorsed by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notarized subscriber signatures
Consent of licensed registered agent to act
Statement of authorized and issued share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any defective or non-compliant clauses identified by the registered agent or notary and re-submit the revised document for execution; no additional state fee is incurred if corrected before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, SIFA, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and the registered agent's consent, and pay the US$200 incorporation fee. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon verification within the statutory turnaround period.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (notarized)
Consent of licensed registered agent
Statutory fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is requisitioned, respond in writing to the Registrar within 14 days with amended documentation; a correction fee may apply, and the application is re-docketed for expedited processing upon full compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Registered Office and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notice of registered office (Form IC-3) and notice of directors and secretary (Form IC-4) within 30 days of incorporation. Maintain the registered office at the licensed registered agent's address in Apia and ensure at least one director is an individual, ordinarily resident or approved by the Registrar where required.
required_dossiers: Form IC-3 (Notice of Registered Office)
Form IC-4 (Notice of Directors and Secretary)
Consent to act from each director and secretary
Copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a defect, file an administrative correction form with corrected officer details and pay the small amendment fee; the Registrar will issue an acknowledgment of the corrected register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening of First Board Meeting and Establishment of Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; licensed registered agent acting as company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the inaugural board meeting or pass the pro-forma first written resolution adopting the constitution, confirming share subscription, fixing the registered office, and appointing officers. Open the statutory records book comprising the share register, minutes, seal register, and members' register, and issue share certificates.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution (written or minutes)
Share register and share certificates
Common seal or electronic seal record
Statutory records book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resolution or minutes are rejected by the registered agent for formal defects, re-execute the corrected resolution and re-file it in the statutory records; no state filing is required for internal records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Captive Reinsurance Operating Licence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Insurance Licensing Division, under the Insurance Act 2007
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a captive reinsurance licence application demonstrating that the company will underwrite risks solely for affiliated enterprises, accompanied by a business plan, actuarial solvency opinion, confirmation of the solvency trust account at a licensed Samoan bank, and declarations of the directors' fitness and probity.
required_dossiers: International Insurance Licence application form
Detailed captive reinsurance business plan
Actuarial certification of reserves and solvency margin
Evidence of the escrow or solvency trust account at a licensed bank in Samoa
Police clearance and banker's reference for each director and officer
Corporate governance and AML/CFT compliance manual
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence application is refused or conditioned, SIFA will issue a written notice of conditions; the applicant may cure deficiencies by amending the business plan, increasing the solvency margin, or restructuring governance, and may seek a review or appeal before the SIFA Appeals Committee within 21 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Insurance Licensing Division

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration Category (low-impact office use; no full EIA report required for a captive reinsurance SPV unless physical claims handling facilities or standby generator installations are added)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge for office-based operations; any standby generator must meet the MNRE ambient air quality thresholds (total suspended particulates below 50 mg/Nm³ and visible emissions not exceeding 20% opacity); noise limited to 55 dB(A) daytime and 45 dB(A) nighttime at the site boundary; waste paper and electronic waste segregated for licensed recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) confirming means of escape, extinguisher placement, and emergency lighting; structural load and building occupancy approval issued by MNRE-PUMA for the registered office premises; and an Occupational Safety and Health clearance from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) confirming compliance with workplace hazard and employee welfare standards, including first aid and electrical certificate of compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (MFR), Government of Samoa, Apia (statutory successor to the Samoa Tax Administration); taxpayer e-services and registration portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: incorporate the captive reinsurance SPV as an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1988 through a SIFA-licensed trustee/agent and obtain the SIFA Certificate of Incorporation, together with a captive reinsurance licence under the International Insurance Act 1995 where required. Step 2: the licensed trustee files with the MFR the SIFA certificate, Memorandum and Articles of Association, directors/shareholders/beneficial-ownership KYC pack, passports, banker's references, and registered-office confirmation. Step 3: the MFR issues a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) record through the eServices portal; no VAGST (VAT) registration number is issued to tax-exempt ICs. Step 4: because the IC elects tax-exempt status, the MFR designates the account 'International Company - Tax Exempt Zone - nil income tax and nil VAGST', and no VAGST registration is effected. Step 5: SIFA/MFR issue the tax-exemption/resident certificate for the SPV's bankers, ceding reinsurers, and foreign withholding-relief purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The International Company is statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax, VAGST, stamp duty, and all dividend/interest/royalty/capital-gains withholding taxes; it is treated as non-resident for Samoan tax purposes, with the SIFA annual licence and government fees as the only fiscal charges; reinsurance premium income and investment earnings fall wholly outside the Samoan tax base.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: On incorporation the IC elects exempt-company, non-resident, or ordinary-resident status in its constitutional documents; changes of classification are made by special resolution with SIFA/MFR consent. No domestic check-the-box regime exists; a US beneficial owner may separately file Form 8832 for US federal tax classification purposes. Samoa has not enacted an elective hybrid-mismatch regime; BEPS Action 2 outcomes are applied through negotiated tax treaties and the Inclusive Framework commitment rather than a shareholder election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) - Samoa's national VAT/GST system
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (or a reasonable expectation of exceeding WST 60,000 in the next 12 months) under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008, as amended; tax-exempt International Companies are outside the registrable VAGST net and must not register for VAGST even if offshore premium flows exceed the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing digital stamping, or API transaction-clearance mandate. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue sequential, MFR-compliant tax invoices (paper or electronic) showing the supplier TIN, buyer TIN/name, invoice date, serial number, supply description, GST-exclusive amount, 15% VAGST amount, and the VAGST registration status; all invoices and bordereaux must be lodged with the MFR on demand and reconciled via the MFR eServices portal. The captive reinsurance IC, being VAGST-exempt, issues underwriter bordereaux, premium statements, and settlement advices instead of Samoan VAGST tax invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A supplier may claim the 0% VAGST rate on: (a) goods physically exported within 30 days of supply; (b) international transport and directly incidental services; (c) services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply, with the benefit consumed wholly offshore; and (d) prescribed insurance/reinsurance services where the underlying risk is located outside Samoa. Premiums, recoveries, and investment income of the captive reinsurance SPV qualify as zero-rated exported reinsurance services for any VAGST-registered company, whereas a tax-exempt International Company simply incurs no VAGST liability; in both cases the risk must be documented as offshore and the counterparty as non-resident.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDEC) or electronic export entry lodged with the Samoa Customs Service evidencing the exported goods
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing actual export within the statutory 30-day window
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or bank SWIFT/MT103 proof of foreign-currency receipt from the non-resident counterparty
Reinsurance policy, slip, bordereaux, or underwriting agreement evidencing offshore risk location, non-resident ceding insurer, and premium/settlement terms
Certified copy of the SIFA tax-exemption certificate/captive licence for the International Company
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False, fabricated, or inadequately documented zero-rating and refund claims trigger: (i) reopening of up to five prior tax years, extendable on evidence of fraud; (ii) retrospective clawback of refunds, input-VAT credits, and zero-rate concessions with statutory interest and late-payment penalties; (iii) shortfall penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2015 of 20% for failure to take reasonable care, 75% for recklessness, and 150% for intentional evasion; (iv) administrative monetary penalties and criminal prosecution with fines and imprisonment for responsible directors/officers; and (v) for licensed ICs, suspension or revocation of the captive insurance licence, loss of tax-exempt status, cancellation of IC registration, and disqualification of the licensed trustee/agent. If FX repatriation is not evidenced within 180 days, the MFR may recharacterise the reinsurance premium flow as a domestic Samoan supply and impose 15% VAGST retroactively, together with the penalties described above.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa) acting as the sole foreign exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act 1977, the Central Bank of Samoa Act 2005, and the Financial Institutions Act 1996 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tālā (WST) is a managed-float currency with limited offshore liquidity. Current-account payments, including insurance premium, reinsurance claims, dividends and interest, are generally permitted without prior exchange control approval, but must be routed through an authorised dealer bank and supported by Form A2 documentation. Capital-account transactions, including capital injections by non-resident group parents, subordinated loan advances, and capital repatriation or dividend distribution, require prior written approval of the Central Bank under the Exchange Control Act. Profit remittance is permitted after lodgement of audited financial statements and an exchange control certificate; in practice processing of a capital-account approval takes four to six weeks, and remittances are not restricted by any dividend withholding tax for Samoa International Companies, but the bank must be given a clear disposal instruction referencing the approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All proceeds from exports of goods or services, including reinsurance services supplied to non-residents, must be repatriated to and received in Samoa within 30 days of the dates the proceeds are deposited offshore or, if received directly, within 30 days of receipt. Unless a foreign-currency retention exemption is granted by the Central Bank of Samoa, 100% of each receipt must be surrendered to and converted into Samoan Tālā on the same business day through an authorised dealer bank. The exporter, including a licensed captive reinsurance SPV, must present the underlying contract and an export declaration; conversion is at the prevailing market rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD/WST) and Operational Account
Operational Account (WST) and Foreign Currency Account (USD)
Operational Account (WST) and USD Retention Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa does not have a domestic digital EMI (electronic money institution) licensing category. Only licensed commercial banks and money-transfer operators under the Financial Institutions Act 1996 and Central Bank AMLCFT Rules may hold client funds and execute foreign-exchange conversions. Foreign EMIs cannot obtain a Samoan lending or deposit license and cannot open a nostro account for the SPV in WST or route SWIFT payments from the captive's premium flows. A non-bank EMI may be acceptable only for incidental expense payments at negligible volume, and never for underwriting reserves, capital escrow, or premium settlement obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In accordance with Samoa's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 and the bank's internal KYC policy, at least one director, one ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), or an authorised signatory with senior authority must appear physically at the branch in Samoa for a face-to-face interview before the company resolution and signature mandate are accepted. Remote onboarding is not permitted without a waiver from the bank's Money Laundering Reporting Officer; in extraordinary cases a bank will accept a certificate of identity issued by a regulated institution plus a live two-factor video call, but this is extremely limited for International Companies in the financial-services sector. A local registered agent, along with certified apostilled extracts of the Certificate of Incorporation and a notarised board resolution, is mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial owner is resident in a high-risk or non-cooperative jurisdiction, or material trustee and fiduciary layers are opaque.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full BO transparency chart; FATF-compliant group AML manual; source-of-wealth affidavit; five years of bank statements from the parent group; apostilled certificates of incorporation and registry extracts for each BO; copies of trust deed and trustee licence; legal opinion confirming the Samoan International Company satisfies section 188 of the International Companies Act for beneficial ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The captive SPV lacks commercial substance and underwriting documentation; it appears to be a dormant or empty-holding vehicle.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Captive management contract with a licensed Samoan captive manager; actuarial opinion on reserves and loss ratios; board minutes and resolutions for each underwriting year; the group's internal reinsurance agreement; premium ledger and associated SWIFT MT103 receipts; regulatory licence or exemption letter from the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) / Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; current certificate of good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual or unexplained large premium flows from multiple non-group subsidiaries or a sudden capital injection inconsistent with the declared business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The executed captive reinsurance treaty; consolidated group chart showing underlying home-country insurance entities; premium allocation schedule; ceding insurer bordereaux and coverage certificates; invoices/periodic risk notifications; cash-flow narrative with purpose codes; corporate approvals from each paying entity; auditor's confirmation that the funds equal declared earned premiums.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds opacity due to funds arriving from omnibus trust accounts, nominee structures in low-disclosure jurisdictions, or intra-company liquidity pumps.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying UBO disclosures and trust deed, or a formal nominee declaration; corroborating bank confirmation letter from the remitting bank; wire trace summary showing only two correspondent hops; asset and source-of-wealth declaration signed by each principal; legal opinion on any off-shore trust; and a sworn statement that no proceeds of crime have been intermingled.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inward equity, regulatory capital, or underwriting collateral must be injected by SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the overseas parent or ceding insurer to the SPV's held USD or WST account at an authorised dealer bank in Samoa. The sending bank must prominently include an appropriate purpose code — e.g., 1100 for equity capital injection, 2110 for insurance premium underwriting, or 2199 for reinsurance claims — in the SWIFT field 70. The Samoan bank will require a copy of the signed reinsurance contract, a board resolution of the SPV and a confirmation letter from the parent stating the value of the premium as calculated by an actuary. On receipt, if the transaction exceeds the bank's threshold, the bank will trigger an exchange-control declaration to the Central Bank and may require the repatriation/surrender of US dollars for any proportion needed to pay local taxes and fees.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Reinsurance claims, profit commission payments and return-premium disbursements to group cedants are settled by SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for correspondent-dependent flows), with GPI tracking and a beneficiary-account pre-validation. A claim file must include a board-approved claims settlement release, the loss reserve certificate, adjuster report, and the ceding company bordereaux. For collateralised reinsurance collateral release, the SPV will use a clean payment instruction through the bank rather than a commercial letter of credit; should an LC be unavoidable in a finance side-collateral agreement, the Samoan dealer bank will issue a fully cash-covered letter of credit (MT700/MT707) with maturity matching the reinsurance loss reserve. All outbound payments above a set threshold are checked by the Exchange Control Department to verify prior approval and tax clearance; no onward remittance is allowed until the bank records the purpose code (e.g., 3610 – reinsurance premium, 3410 – claims settlement).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable plain-vanilla forward contracts in USD/WST, AUD/WST, JPY/WST with tenors up to 12 months, transacted through an authorised dealer bank and reserved strictly against documented reinsurance receivable or ceded claim exposure.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps between WST and USD/AUD/JPY, of one-year minimum notional, permitted on a hedge-only basis and subject to individual pre-approval from the Central Bank of Samoa.

Cash-collateralised foreign-exchange options used as protective collars (zero-cost or cost-reducing) in deliverable currencies, prohibited from naked or speculative trading and executed under a bilateral ISDA/CSA with the dealer bank.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour of Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; annual return must be lodged with the Registrar within 30 days after the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge on the annual government fee; continued non-compliance beyond 6 months after the due date may lead to administrative strike-off of the company and forfeiture of company assets to the Government of Samoa

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Captive Reinsurance SPV Annual License Fee and Confirmation Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of the issuance of the captive insurance license or as otherwise specified in the license conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a penalty of 10% of the unpaid fee; prolonged default beyond 90 days may result in suspension of the insurance license and referral to the Registrar for strike-off proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Standard International Companies incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 are exempt from independent statutory audit. However, a licensed captive reinsurance SPV regulated under the International Insurance Act 2003 must engage a SIFA-approved independent auditor and file audited financial statements annually, irrespective of premium income, asset size, or shareholding structure.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: SIFA and the International Insurance Act prescribe the application of IFRS-based accounting principles for regulated captive reinsurance entities; the International Companies Act requires all ICs to maintain accounting records sufficient to evidence financial position and to produce financial statements considered adequate for audit where required.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must submit an annual beneficial ownership confirmation through its licensed registered agent, declaring current beneficial owners and any transfers or changes in effective shareholding made during the preceding year. The annual renewal is not completed until the UBO confirmation is accepted by the Registrar.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - 8,000 per annum for a captive reinsurance SPV

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for International Company offshore business; domestic corporate income tax rate 27% applies only to income derived from domestic sources by a person other than an International Company or by an IC carrying on unauthorized domestic business
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full income tax exemption on all offshore business income; no capital gains tax on international transactions; no stamp duty on IC instruments; no excise tax on offshore insurance/reinsurance premiums; annual government license fee instead of income tax

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ICA Annual Return (Form AR-IC) under the Samoa International Companies Act 2014; electronic lodgment via Samoa International Companies Registry online portal (ICR Portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation or such other reporting date fixed by the registered agent and filed at registry

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company name and ceremonial registry number as shown on certificate of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must ensure the exact legal name and number match the incorporation certificate exactly

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Samoa and the licensed international registered agent name
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a licensed Samoan registered agent; non-residents may not act as registered agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, nationalities, and identification of each director
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted but at least one director must be a Samoa tax-resident individual unless exempted by the Registrar

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial shareholder details including share classes, allocations, and nominee declarations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose ultimate beneficial owner of any captive SPV including the parent multinational group; nominee disclosure acceptable if accompanied by fully completed BO forms

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Appointment details of secretary, whether in Samoa or foreign; if no secretary, confirm exemption claim
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident secretary acceptable but practical substance requires a Samoan-based administrator for licensed reinsurance SPVs

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of issued capital, statement that no capital is held in bearer form, and declaration of solvency
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For captive reinsurance SPV, confirm paid-up share capital adequacy relative to FISA solvency benchmark

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that operations are wholly offshore and that domestic source activity has not occurred during the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident officers should retain contemporaneous premiums and claims records proving no Samoan domestic risk was underwritten

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of registered agent and director certifying accuracy; the form must be filed with annual fee payment receipt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent signs as licensee; non-resident directors must verify content before authorizing submission

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of SAT 200 plus SAT 20 per day per section of the International Companies Act; default leads to Registrar's notice for striking-off; continued non-compliance results in dissolution of the company; directors and registered agents face disqualification and personal fines up to SAT 50,000

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: FISA Offshore Captive Reinsurance Annual Statistical and Solvency Return (Form CB-RA-01); submitted electronically to Samoa Financial Services Authority (FISA) insurance supervision system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual with quarterly schedule to FISA; premium and claims data submitted as part of supervisory filings
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not later than 3 months after the prescribed financial year-end; for a 31 December FY, filing due by March 31

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Captive reinsurance licence number, entity name, date of licence grant and period covered
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All captive reinsurance license details must match the insurance licence issued by FISA; non-resident directors must ensure correct LIC number

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of reinsurance contracts written: classes of risk, ceding insurer, policy period, geographic scope
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Specify clearly that risks are exclusively non-Samoa risks ceded by a related foreign underwriter; no domestic Samoan risks may be included

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross written premiums, ceded premiums, net premium income, and earned premiums for the period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report in USD or WST with conversion basis; wire premiums must reconcile with Swift records and underwriting reserve account

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claims paid, claims outstanding, unearned premium reserve, and loss reserve computations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident captive managers should provide actuary-certified reserve substantiation if required

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of available assets, required solvency margin, and identifiable assets trust or collateral held
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Assets owned by the captive reinsurer may be held offshore but must be identifiable and controlled by SPV treasury

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Schedule disclosing ultimate parent company group, direct beneficial owner, and any changes of ownership during the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For captive reinsurance SPV, provide the full multinational enterprise group chart, board resolution chain, and directors' declaration of BO status

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement that the licensee has complied with AML/CFT obligations, appointed a compliance officer, and filed suspicious transaction reports as applicable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident captive reinsurer must still appoint a local AML officer or contract FISA-approved service provider

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission attracts administrative penalty of USD 1,000 per month or such amount as FISA determines; false declaration and failure to maintain solvency margin may lead to suspension or revocation of the captive insurance licence, monetary penalty up to USD 250,000, and disqualification of officers under Insurance Act 2007

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions made by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders; Samoa does not impose withholding tax on IC dividends or on branch remittances
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not ordinarily required because domestic IC law exempts distributions; if a treaty benefit is needed in a foreign jurisdiction and Samoa treaty rules apply, the recipient must: (1) obtain a Samoa tax residency certificate from Mineral Resources and Revenue Department / Ministry of Revenue; (2) complete and lodge Samoa IRS Form DTA-A for 'Residence of a Person'; (3) submit a certified copy of the TRC to the foreign withholding agent before the dividend payment date; (4) provide a valid declaration of beneficial ownership and maintain contemporaneous records of the exemption claim
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: an International Company paying interest, royalties, or distribution fees for offshore business is exempt from Samoan withholding tax; in purely domestic context the normal 27% corporate tax would apply but no expectation for internationally licensed SPVs; treaty rates, where applicable, are 0%–10% depending on Samoa's double tax agreements but currently Samoa has limited DTA network

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not statutorily codified for International Companies; prudent controlled transaction threshold for captive reinsurance SPV: SAT 1,500,000 (approx USD 550,000) in aggregate annual related-party reinsurance or service transactions above which contemporaneous Master File and Local File documentation is advised
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa has no general Economic Substance Regulations equivalent to other offshore jurisdictions; however, FISA-licensed captive reinsurance companies must satisfy a de facto economic substance condition: a licensed registered agent with a registered office in Samoa, local resident director (at least one), adequate administrative staff to maintain books and board minutes, local management oversight of reinsurance risk, and performance of key decisions in Samoa; lack of substance may be challenged by foreign Revenue authorities as 'sham entity' or 'conduit SPV'

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion by Domestic Source Business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: International Company underwrites or insures risk located in Samoa or earns Samoan domestic income while continuing to claim the IC tax exemption; or a captive reinsurer issues local policies without a domestic insurance license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of IC tax-exempt status; assessment to all unpaid income tax at 27% for a period of up to seven years; penalty of 200% of underpaid tax plus monthly default interest of 2%; criminal fine up to SAT 1,000,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, including non-resident directors, are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid corporate tax if they knowingly signed an incorrect exemption attestation; criminal conviction for tax evasion carries imprisonment up to seven years; travel ban may issue pending collection of tax debt

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Captive reinsurance SPV is administered without any real physical presence in Samoa, without local board meetings, without business records held at the registered office, or with all decisions executed by the foreign parent group
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: FISA refusal to renew the insurance licence; revocation or suspension of licence with immediate cessation of reinsurance business; fines per Insurance Act 2007 up to SAT 250,000 per non-compliance, and an order for winding-up of the company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of an SPV found to be a sham may be personally liable for outstanding debts of the SPV under the Credit of Unregistered Business doctrine; local director may be disqualified by Samoa Registrar for a maximum of fifteen years; non-resident directors subject to contempt orders and assets-tracing proceedings carried out by theOfficial Administrator

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of the captive reinsurance SPV to launder premium money through layering transactions, failure to conduct customer due diligence on the parent group, failure to file suspicious transaction reports in Samoa, or concealment of beneficial ownership despite a FISA request
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa AML/CFT Act 2009 and FISA directives: civil penalty of up to USD 1,000,000; offence of money laundering carries imprisonment up to 25 years and unlimited fines; licence revocation; forfeiture of all related assets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Sanctioned directors face personal criminal liability, confiscation orders against their personal assets, travel bans, and disqualification from holding directorships in Samoa or any FATF-compliant jurisdiction; a successful conviction results in imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The captive entity accepts reinsurance premiums or acts as a pure risk-pooling vehicle without holding a valid FISA captive insurance license, or exceeds the scope of its licensed activity without regulatory endorsement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: FISA order to cease business and refund premiums; administrative penalty up to USD 500,000; each reinsurance transaction void as against public policy; the entity may not enforce rights under reinsurance agreements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Any director or officer who knowingly allows unlicensed insurance business may incur personal liability for all claims made by ceding insurers; upon insolvency, a court may 'pierce the corporate veil' if the company is a mere façade of the director or parent; directors face prosecution under the Insurance Act with imprisonment up to ten years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False filings and Misrepresentation to Registrar/FISA
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submission of falsified annual returns, forged director consents, inaccurate beneficial ownership declarations, false solvency certificates, or materially misleading premium statements to FISA
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlimited fine or imprisonment up to fourteen years under Samoa Crimes Act; mandatory deregistration; FISA may void the insurance licence; the entity and officers are barred from re-licensure for a period of five years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the false return are personally accountable for restitution to any creditor who relied; the Director of Public Prosecutions may seek an asset freeze order, travel ban, and surrender of passport pending trial; imprisonment sentence is mandatory upon conviction

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The SPV or its parents receive or channel premium funds to a terrorist entity under United Nations Security Council sanctions, or conducts transactions with sanctioned jurisdictions using Swift rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of imprisonment up to 30 years and fine of SAT 2,000,000; freezing order on all assets held by the SPV; termination of the Samoa International Company registration as a matter of public interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with knowledge or imperfect oversight may be prosecuted individually regardless of corporate form; travel bans and extradition may be initiated under Samoa international cooperation legislation; property in Samoa may be confiscated irrespective of legal title held
